examples.pinyin: Qízhōngkǎo kuàiyào dào le, lǎoshī shuō wǒmen kěyǐ qù túshūguǎn duìmiàn de dà jiàoshì kànshū.
examples.english: The midterm exam is coming soon. The teacher said we could use the big classroom across from the library for studying.

examples.chinese: 別的時間可以嗎？
examples.pinyin: Biéde shíjiān kěyǐ ma?
examples.english: Can you swap the time?

examples.chinese: 我們去問老師，也許他可以幫你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen qù wèn lǎoshī, yěxǔ tā kěyǐ bāng nǐ.
examples.english: Let’s ask the teacher; maybe he can help you.

examples.chinese: 好，希望老師可以幫我。
examples.pinyin: Hǎo, xīwàng lǎoshī kěyǐ bāng wǒ.
examples.english: Okay, I hope the teacher has some good ideas.

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 我們可以去問家樂，他非常聰明，我想他懂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen kěyǐ qù wèn Jiālè, tā fēicháng cōngmíng, wǒ xiǎng tā dǒng.
examples.english: We can ask Jiale; he is very smart. I think he understands it.

examples.chinese: 百貨公司裡有很多衣服、鞋子和皮包，都是最新的，所以很多年輕女生喜歡到百貨公司去，漂亮的、流行的衣服，她們都想穿穿看。
examples.pinyin: Bǎihuògōngsī lǐ yǒu hěn duō yīfu, xiézi hé píbāo, dōu shì zuì xīn de, suǒyǐ hěn duō niánqīng nǚshēng xǐhuān dào bǎihuògōngsī qù, piàoliang de, liúxíng de yīfu, tāmen dōu xiǎng chuānchuān kàn.
examples.english: Clothes, shoes and purses in department stores are all the latest; therefore, many young ladies like to go there and try on both beautiful and trendy items.

examples.chinese: 很多年輕男生愛在書店看汽車雜誌，汽車很貴，他們不一定可以買新車，可是都看得很開心。
examples.pinyin: Hěn duō niánqīng nánshēng ài zài shūdiàn kàn qìchē zázhì, qìchē hěn guì, tāmen bù yídìng kěyǐ mǎi xīn chē, kěshì dōu kàn de hěn kāixīn.
examples.english: Many young men like to read car magazines at bookstores. Cars are expensive and they don’t usually have the money to buy new ones; however, they are very happy just by reading those magazines.

examples.chinese: 我覺得有的舊東西很不錯，有的新東西也很有趣，我很喜歡看新車、新衣服，可是因為我的錢不多，所以我不常買。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde yǒude jiù dōngxi hěn búcuò, yǒude xīn dōngxi yě hěn yǒuqù, wǒ hěn xǐhuān kàn xīn chē, xīn yīfu, kěshì yīnwèi wǒ de qián bù duō, suǒyǐ wǒ bù cháng mǎi.
examples.english: I think some old stuff is good and some new ones are interesting. I like to check the new car, new clothes out, but I do not have much money, so I don’t buy them often.

examples.chinese: 沒關係，我們可以下個週末再來看。對了，妳要買鞋子吧？
examples.pinyin: Méiguānxi, wǒmen kěyǐ xià ge zhōumò zài lái kàn. Duìle, nǐ yào mǎi xiézi ba?
examples.english: It’s okay; we can come again next weekend. By the way, you want to buy shoes, don’t you?

examples.chinese: 是啊，因為這個牌子很有名，衣服、褲子和裙子也都很好看，所以很多人買。
examples.pinyin: Shì a, yīnwèi zhè ge páizi hěn yǒumíng, yīfu, kùzi hé qúnzi yě dōu hěn hǎokàn, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén mǎi.
examples.english: Yes, it is. This brand is very famous and its tops, pants and skirts are very beautiful, so many people buy it.

examples.chinese: 從我家到機場也不遠，開車去、坐捷運去都可以。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ jiā dào jīchǎng yě bù yuǎn, kāichē qù, zuò jiéyùn qù dōu kěyǐ.
examples.english: It is not far from my house to the airport. I can go by car or MRT.

examples.chinese: 坐捷運又方便又舒服，我們可以坐捷運。
examples.pinyin: Zuò jiéyùn yòu fāngbiàn yòu shūfu, wǒmen kěyǐ zuò jiéyùn.
examples.english: Taking the MRT is convenient and comfortable. We can take the MRT.

examples.chinese: 聽說那家飯店不遠，我想我們可以從學校走路去。
examples.pinyin: Tīngshuō nà jiā fàndiàn bù yuǎn, wǒ xiǎng wǒmen kěyǐ cóng xuéxiào zǒulù qù.
examples.english: I heard that the hotel is not far; I think we can go there from the school on foot.

examples.chinese: 我也不知道。我們可以先上網看地圖。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù zhīdào. Wǒmen kěyǐ xiān shàngwǎng kàn dìtú.
examples.english: I don’t know either. We can check the map online first.

examples.chinese: 你不要常常在家上網、看電腦、玩手機，應該去運動。明天我有空，我們可以一起去騎腳踏車。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào chángcháng zài jiā shàngwǎng, kàn diànnǎo, wán shǒujī, yīnggāi qù yùndòng. Míngtiān wǒ yǒukòng, wǒmen kěyǐ yìqǐ qù qí jiǎotàchē.
examples.english: Don’t surf the internet, use the computer or play on the cell phone at home often. You should go exercise. I am available tomorrow. We can go ride bikes together.

examples.chinese: 你回家經過賣韓國貨的超市時，可以順便幫我買兩包泡麵嗎？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ huíjiā jīngguò mài Hánguó huò de chāoshì shí, kěyǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi liǎng bāo pàomiàn ma?
examples.english: When you pass by the supermarket that sells Korean merchandise on your way home, can you conveniently buy me two packs of instant noodles?

examples.chinese: 客人：這雙皮鞋我穿起來太緊了， 可以幫我換大一點的嗎？ 店員：沒問題，我幫你拿大一號的。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén: Zhè shuāng píxié wǒ chuān qǐlái tài jǐn le, kěyǐ bāng wǒ huàn dà yīdiǎn de ma? Diànyuán: Méi wèntí, wǒ bāng nǐ ná dà yī hào de.
examples.english: Customer: This pair of leather shoes is too tight for me; can you help me exchange them for a bigger size? Clerk: No problem, I'll get you a size larger.

examples.chinese: 冬天一到，我的皮膚就變得很乾，所以得注意保養。
examples.pinyin: Dōngtiān yí dào, wǒ de pífū jiù biàn de hěn gān, suǒyǐ děi zhùyì bǎoyǎng.
examples.english: As soon as winter arrives, my skin becomes very dry, so I have to pay attention to skincare.

examples.chinese: 我媽媽很會保養，看起來又年輕又漂亮，很多人都以為我們是姊妹。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ māma hěn huì bǎoyǎng, kàn qǐlái yòu niánqīng yòu piàoliang, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒmen shì jiěmèi.
examples.english: My mother is very good at taking care of herself; she looks both young and pretty, and many people think we are sisters.

examples.chinese: 醫生說那個病人得住院，要是三天以內都沒發燒、頭也不痛了，就可以出院了。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō nàge bìngrén děi zhùyuàn, yàoshi sān tiān yǐnèi dōu méi fāshāo, tóu yě bú tòng le, jiù kěyǐ chūyuàn le.
examples.english: The doctor said that patient has to be hospitalized; if within three days he has no fever and his head no longer hurts, then he can be discharged.

examples.chinese: 我喜歡在網路商店購物，除了能省不少時間，還可以把商品送到家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuān zài wǎnglù shāngdiàn gòuwù, chúle néng shěng bùshǎo shíjiān, hái kěyǐ bǎ shāngpǐn sòng dào jiā.
examples.english: I like to go shopping at online stores; besides saving a lot of time, they can also deliver the goods to your home.

examples.chinese: 那所雙語學校強調，除了中文課以外，其他的課程都是用英文上的。
examples.pinyin: Nà suǒ shuāngyǔ xuéxiào qiángdiào, chúle Zhōngwén kè yǐwài, qítā de kèchéng dōu shì yòng Yīngwén shàng de.
examples.english: That bilingual school emphasizes that, except for Chinese classes, all other courses are taught in English.

examples.chinese: 我舅舅在公司的表現樣樣都好，所以老闆打算明年讓他當經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiùjiu zài gōngsī de biǎoxiàn yàngyàng dōu hǎo, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn dǎsuàn míngnián ràng tā dāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: My uncle's performance at the company is good in every aspect, so the boss plans to make him manager next year.

examples.chinese: 我覺得住在鄉下除了購物不方便以外，什麼都好。我的房東只提供家具、電視和冰箱，以外的東西他不管。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde zhù zài xiāngxià chúle gòuwù bù fāngbiàn yǐwài, shénme dōu hǎo. Wǒ de fángdōng zhǐ tígōng jiājù, diànshì hé bīngxiāng, yǐwài de dōngxi tā bù guǎn.
examples.english: I think that living in the countryside, apart from shopping being inconvenient, everything is good. My landlord only provides furniture, a TV, and a refrigerator; he doesn't care about things beyond that.

examples.chinese: 孔先生很重視生活品質，也很喜歡做家事，所以總是把家裡整理得乾乾淨淨的。
examples.pinyin: Kǒng xiānshēng hěn zhòngshì shēnghuó pǐnzhí, yě hěn xǐhuān zuò jiāshì, suǒyǐ zǒngshì bǎ jiālǐ zhěnglǐ de gāngānjìngjìng de.
examples.english: Mr. Kong values quality of life very much and also likes doing housework, so he always organizes his home until it is clean and tidy.

examples.chinese: 因為停電了，想要知道颱風的消息，只能聽收音機的廣播。這個活動會場有服務中心，想找人的話，可以請服務人員廣播。
examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tíngdiàn le, xiǎng yào zhīdào táifēng de xiāoxi, zhǐ néng tīng shōuyīnjī de guǎngbō. Zhège huódòng huìchǎng yǒu fúwù zhōngxīn, xiǎng zhǎo rén de huà, kěyǐ qǐng fúwù rényuán guǎngbō.
examples.english: Because the power is out, if you want to know news about the typhoon, you can only listen to the radio broadcast. There is a service center at this event venue; if you want to find someone, you can ask the service staff to make an announcement.

examples.chinese: 現在的科技很進步，萬一迷了路，就可以利用網路地圖找到回家的路。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de kējì hěn jìnbù, wànyī mí le lù, jiù kěyǐ lìyòng wǎnglù dìtú zhǎo dào huí jiā de lù.
examples.english: Technology is very advanced now; in case you get lost, you can use online maps to find the way home.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 臺灣人在國外碰到問題時，可以立刻打0800-085-095「你幫我，你救我」這支電話求救。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān rén zài guówài pèngdào wèntí shí, kěyǐ lìkè dǎ 0800-085-095 “nǐ bāng wǒ, nǐ jiù wǒ” zhè zhī diànhuà qiújiù.
examples.english: When Taiwanese people encounter problems abroad, they can immediately call 0800-085-095, the “you help me, you save me” number, to ask for help.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 當軍隊一到達災區，就聽到了求救的聲音，所以立刻開始救災工作。
examples.pinyin: Dāng jūnduì yí dàodá zāiqū, jiù tīngdào le qiújiù de shēngyīn, suǒyǐ lìkè kāishǐ jiùzāi gōngzuò.
examples.english: As soon as the military arrived at the disaster area, they heard calls for help, so they immediately began disaster relief work.

examples.chinese: 醫生的工作是讓病人恢復健康，甚至把寶貴的生命救回來，所以我們應該尊敬醫生。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng de gōngzuò shì ràng bìngrén huīfù jiànkāng, shènzhì bǎ bǎoguì de shēngmìng jiù huílái, suǒyǐ wǒmen yīnggāi zūnjìng yīshēng.
examples.english: A doctor's job is to help patients recover their health, and even to save precious life back, so we should respect doctors.

examples.chinese: 沒有人知道自己的命能有多長， 所以每天都應該好好過日子。不少人相信人的命是被決定的， 誰都改變不了。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu rén zhīdào zìjǐ de mìng néng yǒu duō cháng, suǒyǐ měi tiān dōu yīnggāi hǎohǎo guò rìzi. Bùshǎo rén xiāngxìn rén de mìng shì bèi juédìng de, shéi dōu gǎibiàn bù liǎo.
examples.english: No one knows how long their own life can be, so every day one should live life well. Many people believe that a person's fate is decided, and no one can change it.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 公司很重視員工的身心健康，每年都安排一連五天的環島旅行，家人也可以參加。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī hěn zhòngshì yuángōng de shēnxīn jiànkāng, měi nián dōu ānpái yīlián wǔ tiān de huándǎo lǚxíng, jiārén yě kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: The company places great importance on the physical and mental health of its employees, and every year arranges a five-day island tour, which family members can also join.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

examples.chinese: 珍珍每天大約看兩個小時的臺灣連續劇，目的是要(訓)練自己的中文聽力。大雄常利用週末練(習)書法，所以漢字寫得比其他同學都好看。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhēn měitiān dàyuē kàn liǎng ge xiǎoshí de Táiwān liánxùjù, mùdì shì yào xùnliàn zìjǐ de Zhōngwén tīnglì. Dàxióng cháng lìyòng zhōumò liànxí shūfǎ, suǒyǐ Hànzì xiě de bǐ qítā tóngxué dōu hǎokàn.
examples.english: Zhenzhen watches about two hours of Taiwanese TV dramas every day; her purpose is to train her Chinese listening comprehension. Daxiong often uses his weekends to practice calligraphy, so he writes Chinese characters more beautifully than any of his classmates.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 張先生以為喝醉了就能把痛苦忘掉，沒想到越喝越痛苦。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng yǐwéi hē zuì le jiù néng bǎ tòngkǔ wàng diào, méi xiǎngdào yuè hē yuè tòngkǔ.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang thought that getting drunk would let him forget his pain, but unexpectedly, the more he drank, the more painful he felt.

examples.chinese: 何小姐地個性溫柔，笑起來也很迷人，所以追求她的人很多。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiǎojiě de gèxìng wēnróu, xiào qǐlái yě hěn mírén, suǒyǐ zhuīqiú tā de rén hěn duō.
examples.english: Miss He has a gentle personality and her smile is very charming, so many people pursue her.

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報說，從明天起一連三天，中部以北地氣溫只有十五度，出門時最好加件外套。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào shuō, cóng míngtiān qǐ yīlián sān tiān, zhōngbù yǐběi dìqū qìwēn zhǐyǒu shíwǔ dù, chūmén shí zuìhǎo jiā jiàn wàitào.
examples.english: The weather forecast says that starting tomorrow for three days in a row, the temperature in the central and northern regions will be only 15 degrees; when going out, it's best to add a jacket.

examples.chinese: 「了」這個詞的用法可以代表事情完成或情況改變。
examples.pinyin: 「le」 zhège cí de yòngfǎ kěyǐ dàibiǎo shìqíng wánchéng huò qíngkuàng gǎibiàn.
examples.english: The usage of the word 'le' can represent the completion of an action or a change in situation.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 有人說發生大地震以前，小動物會亂跑、亂叫，這是很自然的現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō fāshēng dà dìzhèn yǐqián, xiǎo dòngwù huì luàn pǎo, luàn jiào, zhè shì hěn zìrán de xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some people say that before a major earthquake occurs, small animals will run around and make noise; this is a very natural phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 那位老太太年紀大了，沒辦法照顧他的狗，所以想幫狗找個新主人。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎotàitai niánjì dà le, méi bànfǎ zhàogù tā de gǒu, suǒyǐ xiǎng bāng gǒu zhǎo ge xīn zhǔrén.
examples.english: That old lady is advanced in age and has no way to take care of her dog, so she wants to find a new owner for the dog.

examples.chinese: 不少外國人說，臺灣最大的魅力是人們能夠接受不同的文化、語言和想法，所以在臺灣生活非常自在。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō, Táiwān zuì dà de mèilì shì rénmen nénggòu jiēshòu bùtóng de wénhuà, yǔyán hé xiǎngfǎ, suǒyǐ zài Táiwān shēnghuó fēicháng zìzài.
examples.english: Many foreigners say that Taiwan's greatest charm is that people can accept different cultures, languages, and ideas, so living in Taiwan is very comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這次的露營活動因為颱風辦不成了，可以說計畫永遠沒辦法趕上變化。張老闆開會開得太久，沒趕上飛機，只好花錢再買一張機票了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì de lùyíng huódòng yīnwèi táifēng bàn bù chéng le, kěyǐ shuō jìhuà yǒngyuǎn méi bànfǎ gǎnshàng biànhuà. Zhāng lǎobǎn kāihuì kāi de tài jiǔ, méi gǎnshàng fēijī, zhǐhǎo huā qián zài mǎi yī zhāng jīpiào le.
examples.english: This camping activity couldn't be held because of the typhoon; you could say that plans can never catch up with changes. Boss Zhang's meeting went on too long, and he didn't catch the plane, so he had no choice but to spend money to buy another ticket.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 小陳認為頭痛是小事，況且最近忙得連休息的時間都不夠，所以不肯去看病。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Chén rènwéi tóutòng shì xiǎoshì, kuàngqiě zuìjìn máng de lián xiūxi de shíjiān dōu bù gòu, suǒyǐ bù kěn qù kànbìng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Chén thinks a headache is a small matter; furthermore, recently he has been so busy that he doesn't even have enough time to rest, so he refuses to see a doctor.

examples.chinese: 小張不僅長得帥，穿著也很有品味，所以很多人都以為他是明星。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng bùjǐn zhǎng de shuài, chuānzhuó yě hěn yǒu pǐnwèi, suǒyǐ hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi tā shì míngxīng.
examples.english: Xiǎo Zhāng is not only handsome but also dresses with great taste, so many people think he is a celebrity.

examples.chinese: 老師認為這個問題很難，只有一個學生回答得很正確，所以給他加了一些分數。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī rènwéi zhège wèntí hěn nán, zhǐyǒu yí ge xuésheng huídá de hěn zhèngquè, suǒyǐ gěi tā jiā le yìxiē fēnshù.
examples.english: The teacher thought this question was very difficult, and only one student answered very correctly, so he gave him some extra points.

examples.chinese: 這堂課的內容跟文化有關，所以老師把教學重心放在介紹各國的文化特色。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng kè de nèiróng gēn wénhuà yǒuguān, suǒyǐ lǎoshī bǎ jiàoxué zhòngxīn fàng zài jièshào gè guó de wénhuà tèsè.
examples.english: The content of this class is related to culture, so the teacher put the teaching focus on introducing the cultural characteristics of various countries.

examples.chinese: 我同學記筆記的速度很快，也記得很清楚，所以我常跟他借筆記來複習功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngxué jì bǐjì de sùdù hěn kuài, yě jì de hěn qīngchu, suǒyǐ wǒ cháng gēn tā jiè bǐjì lái fùxí gōngkè.
examples.english: My classmate takes notes very quickly and also remembers them very clearly, so I often borrow his notes to review my lessons.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人使用網路上課，所以手機、電腦也就變成了重要的學習工具。
examples.pinyin: Yuèláiyuè duō rén shǐyòng wǎnglù shàngkè, suǒyǐ shǒujī, diànnǎo yě jiù biànchéng le zhòngyào de xuéxí gōngjù.
examples.english: More and more people use the Internet for classes, so mobile phones and computers have also become important learning tools.

examples.chinese: 這堂語法課的內容比較難，學生有任何問題都可以舉手請教老師。
examples.pinyin: Zhè táng yǔfǎ kè de nèiróng bǐjiào nán, xuéshēng yǒu rènhé wèntí dōu kěyǐ jǔshǒu qǐngjiào lǎoshī.
examples.english: The content of this grammar class is relatively difficult; students can raise their hands to ask the teacher for advice if they have any questions.

examples.chinese: 李小姐結婚以後的生活重心就是家庭，尤其是照顧剛出生的小孩。
examples.pinyin: Lǐ xiǎojiě jiéhūn yǐhòu de shēnghuó zhòngxīn jiùshì jiātíng, yóuqí shì zhàogù gāng chūshēng de xiǎohái.
examples.english: After Miss Li got married, the focus of her life is her family, especially taking care of her newborn child.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: A:你知道辦理留學的手續需要準備哪些資料嗎？ B:我不清楚。你可以上網查查。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zhīdào bànlǐ liúxué de shǒuxù xūyào zhǔnbèi nǎxiē zīliào ma? B: Wǒ bù qīngchu. Nǐ kěyǐ shàngwǎng cháchá.
examples.english: A: Do you know what materials need to be prepared to deal with the procedures for studying abroad? B: I'm not sure. You can look it up online.

examples.chinese: 大雄從小個性就很被動，別人要求的事他才做，父母跟老師都希望他可以主動一點。
examples.pinyin: Dàxióng cóngxiǎo gèxìng jiù hěn bèidòng, biérén yāoqiú de shì tā cái zuò, fùmǔ gēn lǎoshī dōu xīwàng tā kěyǐ zhǔdòng yīdiǎn.
examples.english: Daxiong has been passive in personality since childhood; he only does things when others ask him to. His parents and teachers all hope he can be a bit more proactive.

examples.chinese: 這次颱風引起的水災太嚴重，害大家一連五天沒有乾淨的水可以用。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì táifēng yǐnqǐ de shuǐzāi tài yánzhòng, hài dàjiā yīlián wǔ tiān méiyǒu gānjìng de shuǐ kěyǐ yòng.
examples.english: The flood caused by this typhoon was too serious, causing everyone to go five days in a row without clean water to use.

examples.chinese: 公司向每位員工發出健檢通知，上面寫著檢查時間、地點和需要注意的事情。地震救災人員聽到東邊大約五公尺以外的地方，有人發出求救的聲音，就立刻趕過去救人。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī xiàng měi wèi yuángōng fāchū jiànjiǎn tōngzhī, shàngmiàn xiě zhe jiǎnchá shíjiān, dìdiǎn hé xūyào zhùyì de shìqíng. Dìzhèn jiùzāi rényuán tīngdào dōngbiān dàyuē wǔ gōngchǐ yǐwài de dìfāng, yǒu rén fāchū qiújiù de shēngyīn, jiù lìkè gǎn guòqù jiù rén.
examples.english: The company sent out a health check notice to every employee, with the examination time, location, and matters needing attention written on it. Earthquake rescue workers heard someone send out a cry for help from a place about five meters to the east, so they immediately rushed over to rescue the person.

examples.chinese: 去朋友家以前，一定要約好時間才去，這是做人的基本禮貌。孔子認為對人有禮貌、尊敬老師、孝順父母，是做人的基本。
examples.pinyin: Qù péngyǒu jiā yǐqián, yīdìng yào yuēhǎo shíjiān cái qù, zhè shì zuòrén de jīběn lǐmào. Kǒngzǐ rènwéi duì rén yǒu lǐmào, zūnjìng lǎoshī, xiàoshùn fùmǔ, shì zuòrén de jīběn.
examples.english: Before going to a friend's house, you must set a time before going; this is basic courtesy in dealing with people. Confucius believed that being polite to others, respecting teachers, and being filial to parents are the basics of being a person.

examples.chinese: 只要你堅持每天學習一個小時的中文，我保證你的程度一定會越來越好的。石先生對自己的想法很堅持，從不接受別人的意見，所以很難相處。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào nǐ jiānchí měitiān xuéxí yí ge xiǎoshí de Zhōngwén, wǒ bǎozhèng nǐ de chéngdù yídìng huì yuèláiyuè hǎo de. Shí xiānsheng duì zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ hěn jiānchí, cóng bù jiēshòu biérén de yìjiàn, suǒyǐ hěn nán xiāngchǔ.
examples.english: As long as you insist on studying Chinese for one hour every day, I guarantee your level will definitely get better and better. Mr. Shi is very insistent on his own ideas and never accepts others' opinions, so he is hard to get along with.

examples.chinese: 這部戲的男主角英俊、女主角漂亮，加上演員都演得很好，所以非常受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Zhè bù xì de nán zhǔjué yīngjùn, nǚ zhǔjué piàoliang, jiāshàng yǎnyuán dōu yǎn de hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ fēicháng shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: The male lead in this drama is handsome and the female lead is pretty; moreover, all the actors act very well, so it is extremely popular.

examples.chinese: 這個保養品很適合皮膚乾的人，所以秋冬兩個季節銷售得非常好。因為店員的服務態度很好，所以這個專櫃的銷售成績是最好的。
examples.pinyin: Zhège bǎoyǎngpǐn hěn shìhé pífū gān de rén, suǒyǐ qiū dōng liǎng ge jìjié xiāoshòu de fēicháng hǎo. Yīnwèi diànyuán de fúwù tàidù hěn hǎo, suǒyǐ zhège zhuān guì de xiāoshòu chéngjì shì zuì hǎo de.
examples.english: This skincare product is very suitable for people with dry skin, so its sales in the autumn and winter seasons are very good. Because the staff's service attitude is very good, this counter's sales performance is the best.

examples.chinese: 要是你覺得這盤菜的味道太淡了，可以加一點醬料。
examples.pinyin: Yàoshi nǐ juéde zhè pán cài de wèidào tài dàn le, kěyǐ jiā yìdiǎn jiàngliào.
examples.english: If you feel this dish's flavor is too light, you can add a little sauce.

examples.chinese: 每個人心中都有理想的交友條件，比如年齡幾歲以下，身高幾公分以上，但我只要對方愛我就好了。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge rén xīnzhōng dōu yǒu lǐxiǎng de jiāoyǒu tiáojiàn, bǐrú niánlíng jǐ suì yǐxià, shēngāo jǐ gōngfēn yǐshàng, dàn wǒ zhǐyào duìfāng ài wǒ jiù hǎo le.
examples.english: Everyone has ideal conditions for making friends in their heart, such as age below a certain number of years old, height above a certain number of centimeters, but for me, as long as the other person loves me, that's enough.

examples.chinese: 有一些交友網站上的個人姓名、年齡等資料都是假的，所以上網交友要小心。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē jiāoyǒu wǎngzhàn shàng de gèrén xìngmíng, niánlíng děng zīliào dōu shì jiǎ de, suǒyǐ shàngwǎng jiāoyǒu yào xiǎoxīn.
examples.english: Some personal information such as names and ages on dating websites is false, so you need to be careful when making friends online.

examples.chinese: 我住的地方不算偏僻，但是附近沒有公車站，所以自行車成了我最常利用的交通工具。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhù de dìfāng bù suàn piānpì, dànshì fùjìn méiyǒu gōngchēzhàn, suǒyǐ zìxíngchē chéng le wǒ zuì cháng lìyòng de jiāotōng gōngjù.
examples.english: The place I live is not considered remote, but there is no bus stop nearby, so the bicycle has become the transportation tool I use most often.

examples.chinese: 小李好幾次約女網友見面，都被拒絕，所以不再跟她聯絡了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lǐ hǎojǐ cì yuē nǚ wǎngyǒu jiànmiàn, dōu bèi jùjué, suǒyǐ bù zài gēn tā liánluò le.
examples.english: Xiao Li asked his female online friend to meet several times but was rejected each time, so he no longer contacts her.

examples.chinese: 透過社群網站，我們可以加入感興趣的社團，讓自己的生活更充實。
examples.pinyin: Tòuguò shèqún wǎngzhàn, wǒmen kěyǐ jiārù gǎn xìngqù de shètuán, ràng zìjǐ de shēnghuó gèng chōngshí.
examples.english: Through social media, we can join clubs we are interested in, making our lives more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，父母在孩子的心中是最偉大的，沒有人可以取代。
examples.pinyin: Yìbān lái shuō, fùmǔ zài háizi de xīnzhōng shì zuì wěidà de, méiyǒu rén kěyǐ qǔdài.
examples.english: Generally speaking, parents are the greatest in their children's hearts; no one can replace them.

examples.chinese: 有了無線網路，就可以隨時隨地上網查資料、看影片，或是玩遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu le wúxiàn wǎnglù, jiù kěyǐ suíshísuídì shàngwǎng chá zīliào, kàn yǐngpiàn, huòshì wán yóuxì.
examples.english: With wireless internet, you can go online anytime, anywhere to look up information, watch videos, or play games.

examples.chinese: 假如貴公司想擴大生產規模，可以參考本公司的作法，我們很願意提供協助。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú guì gōngsī xiǎng kuòdà shēngchǎn guīmó, kěyǐ cānkǎo běn gōngsī de zuòfǎ, wǒmen hěn yuànyì tígōng xiézhù.
examples.english: If your honorable company wants to expand production scale, you can refer to our company's methods; we are very willing to provide assistance.

examples.chinese: A:對這次新產品的銷售方式，你有什麼想法？ B:我在這方面沒什麼經驗，你可以去請教方經理。
examples.pinyin: A: Duì zhè cì xīn chǎnpǐn de xiāoshòu fāngshì, nǐ yǒu shénme xiǎngfǎ? B: Wǒ zài zhè fāngmiàn méi shénme jīngyàn, nǐ kěyǐ qù qǐngjiào Fāng jīnglǐ.
examples.english: A: Regarding the sales method for this new product, what ideas do you have? B: I don't have much experience in this aspect; you can go ask Manager Fang.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 現代人往往以網路傳訊息，代替傳統寫信或打電話的方式。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài rén wǎngwǎng yǐ wǎnglù chuán xiāoxi, dàitì chuántǒng xiě xìn huò dǎ diànhuà de fāngshì.
examples.english: Modern people often use the internet to send messages, replacing the traditional ways of writing letters or making phone calls.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 紀先生的部落格擁有不少讀者，下個週末他要辦一場新書活動，買了新書的讀者都可以請他簽名。
examples.pinyin: Jì xiānsheng de bùluògé yōngyǒu bùshǎo dúzhě, xià gè zhōumò tā yào bàn yī chǎng xīnshū huódòng, mǎi le xīnshū de dúzhě dōu kěyǐ qǐng tā qiānmíng.
examples.english: Mr. Ji's blog has quite a few readers; next weekend he will hold a new book event, and readers who have bought the new book can ask him for an autograph.

examples.chinese: 公園附近的停車場還很空，你可以把車停到那裡去。
examples.pinyin: Gōngyuán fùjìn de tíngchēchǎng hái hěn kōng, nǐ kěyǐ bǎ chē tíng dào nàlǐ qù.
examples.english: The parking lot near the park is still very empty; you can park your car there.

examples.chinese: 小簡今天遇到以前的女朋友，跟她喝了咖啡才回家，但不敢跟太太說實話。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Jiǎn jīntiān yùdào yǐqián de nǚpéngyǒu, gēn tā hē le kāfēi cái huí jiā, dàn bù gǎn gēn tàitai shuō shíhuà.
examples.english: Today Xiao Jian ran into his ex-girlfriend, and only went home after having coffee with her, but he didn't dare tell his wife the truth.

examples.chinese: 這本小說是以愛情的題材寫成的，後來被拍成了一部浪漫的電影。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō shì yǐ àiqíng de tícái xiě chéng de, hòulái bèi pāi chéng le yī bù làngmàn de diànyǐng.
examples.english: This novel is written with a love theme, and was later made into a romantic movie.

examples.chinese: 現在的電腦處理資料的速度比以往快得多，功能也更多了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài de diànnǎo chǔlǐ zīliào de sùdù bǐ yǐwǎng kuài de duō, gōngnéng yě gèng duō le.
examples.english: Today's computers process data much faster than in the past, and have more functions.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 外國人在臺灣生活期間，如果遇到任何問題，都可以打0800-024111，請求協助。那個壞人殺了人，他知道自己錯了，到教堂去請求上帝原諒。
examples.pinyin: 1. Wàiguórén zài Táiwān shēnghuó qījiān, rúguǒ yùdào rènhé wèntí, dōu kěyǐ dǎ 0800-024111, qǐngqiú xiézhù. 2. Nàge huàirén shā le rén, tā zhīdào zìjǐ cuò le, dào jiàotáng qù qǐngqiú Shàngdì yuánliàng.
examples.english: 1. During their time living in Taiwan, if foreigners encounter any problems, they can call 0800-024111 to request assistance. 2. That bad person killed someone; he knew he was wrong and went to church to beg God for forgiveness.

examples.chinese: 按照華人的習俗，紅包裡面的錢不可以是四百、四千等等。
examples.pinyin: Ànzhào Huárén de xísú, hóngbāo lǐmiàn de qián bù kěyǐ shì sìbǎi, sìqiān děngděng.
examples.english: According to Chinese customs, the money inside a red envelope cannot be 400, 4000, etc.

examples.chinese: A:犯錯的人都可以請求原諒嗎？ B:得看他犯的是什麼錯，要是小小的錯，就該原諒吧。
examples.pinyin: A: Fàncuò de rén dōu kěyǐ qǐngqiú yuánliàng ma? B: Děi kàn tā fàn de shì shénme cuò, yàoshi xiǎoxiǎo de cuò, jiù gāi yuánliàng ba.
examples.english: A: Can everyone who makes a mistake ask for forgiveness? B: It depends on what mistake he made; if it's a small mistake, then he should be forgiven.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的主題跟銷售新產品有關，所以廣告部門的人員得參加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de zhǔtí gēn xiāoshòu xīn chǎnpǐn yǒuguān, suǒyǐ guǎnggào bùmén de rényuán děi cānjiā.
examples.english: The theme of this meeting is related to selling new products, so the personnel from the advertising department must attend.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 姊姊有了自己的孩子以後，才體會到當父母是很辛苦的。
examples.pinyin: Jiějie yǒu le zìjǐ de háizi yǐhòu, cái tǐhuì dào dāng fùmǔ shì hěn xīnkǔ de.
examples.english: Only after having her own child did my older sister realize that being a parent is very hard.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 有人以為身體沒什麼毛病就代表很健康，這樣的想法事實上不完全正確。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén yǐwéi shēntǐ méi shénme máobìng jiù dàibiǎo hěn jiànkāng, zhèyàng de xiǎngfǎ shìshíshàng bù wánquán zhèngquè.
examples.english: Some people think that if the body has no problems, it means being very healthy; in fact, this idea is not entirely correct.

examples.chinese: 絕大部分的華人都很重視春節，所以回家團圓、互相拜年，他們認為都是該做的。
examples.pinyin: Jué dà bùfèn de Huárén dōu hěn zhòngshì Chūnjié, suǒyǐ huíjiā tuányuán, hùxiāng bàinián, tāmen rènwéi dōu shì gāi zuò de.
examples.english: The vast majority of Chinese people value the Spring Festival highly, so they believe that going home for family reunions and exchanging New Year greetings are things that should be done.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 這條路不平，有民眾貼了海報，請大家走路時要小心，以免受傷。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo lù bù píng, yǒu mínzhòng tiē le hǎibào, qǐng dàjiā zǒulù shí yào xiǎoxīn, yǐmiǎn shòushāng.
examples.english: This road is uneven, and some people have put up posters asking everyone to be careful when walking, in order to avoid getting hurt.

examples.chinese: 像食物銀行、愛心冰箱此類處理食物的做法，不但可以節省資源，還能幫助需要的人。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng shíwù yínháng, àixīn bīngxiāng cǐ lèi chǔlǐ shíwù de zuòfǎ, bùdàn kěyǐ jiéshěng zīyuán, hái néng bāngzhù xūyào de rén.
examples.english: This kind of approach to handling food, such as food banks and love refrigerators, not only can save resources but also can help people in need.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 理論上，有空氣、水、食物就可以維持生命，但還是得看實際的情況。著名的科學家愛因斯坦（ Àiyīnsītǎn, Albert Einstein）發明了相對論（Theory of Relativity），這個理論對後來的科學研究產生了重大的影響。
examples.pinyin: Lǐlùn shàng, yǒu kōngqì, shuǐ, shíwù jiù kěyǐ wéichí shēngmìng, dàn háishì děi kàn shíjì de qíngkuàng. Zhùmíng de kēxuéjiā Àiyīnsītǎn fāmíng le xiāngduìlùn, zhège lǐlùn duì hòulái de kēxué yánjiū chǎnshēng le zhòngdà de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: In theory, with air, water, and food, life can be maintained, but it still depends on the actual situation. The famous scientist Albert Einstein developed the theory of relativity; this theory had a major impact on later scientific research.

items.wordHook: a 人(person) checks a map and points the route → 以(according to).

examples.chinese: 母親節那天，我親自做了一個大蛋糕，送給最親愛的媽媽。
examples.pinyin: Mǔqīnjié nà tiān, wǒ qīnzì zuò le yī gè dà dàngāo, sòng gěi zuì qīn'ài de māma.
examples.english: On Mother's Day, I personally made a big cake and gave it to my dearest mother.

examples.chinese: 不管是誰，如果失去了親愛的家人，一定會很傷心、很痛苦，這是很自然的。那個女演員演戲的樣子很自然，一點也不誇張，難怪導演很欣賞她。
examples.pinyin: Bùguǎn shì shéi, rúguǒ shīqù le qīn'ài de jiārén, yīdìng huì hěn shāngxīn, hěn tòngkǔ, zhè shì hěn zìrán de. Nàge nǚ yǎnyuán yǎnxì de yàngzi hěn zìrán, yīdiǎn yě bù kuāzhāng, nánguài dǎoyǎn hěn xīnshǎng tā.
examples.english: No matter who it is, if they lose a beloved family member, they will certainly be very sad and in great pain; this is very natural. That actress's acting is very natural, not exaggerated at all; no wonder the director appreciates her.

examples.chinese: 父母是我最親愛的家人，誰都不能代替他們在我心中的地位。
examples.pinyin: Fùmǔ shì wǒ zuì qīn'ài de jiārén, shéi dōu bù néng dàitì tāmen zài wǒ xīnzhōng de dìwèi.
examples.english: My parents are my dearest family members; no one can replace their place in my heart.

examples.chinese: 孩子是父母最親愛的寶貝，父母對他們的愛是沒辦法用文字來形容的。
examples.pinyin: Háizi shì fùmǔ zuì qīn'ài de bǎobèi, fùmǔ duì tāmen de ài shì méi bànfǎ yòng wénzì lái xíngróng de.
examples.english: Children are their parents' most beloved treasures; parents' love for them cannot be described in words.

items.wordHook: Combining 親(relatives) and 愛(love): 親愛 means dear.

examples.chinese: 上課時他把筆記寫在本子上，也把重點寫在不同顏色的便條(紙)上。
examples.pinyin: Shàngkè shí tā bǎ bǐjì xiě zài běnzi shàng, yě bǎ zhòngdiǎn xiě zài bùtóng yánsè de biàntiáo (zhǐ) shàng.
examples.english: During class he wrote the notes in his notebook, and also wrote the key points on sticky notes of different colors.

examples.chinese: 康小姐的工作能力很強，能一面掌握會議的重點，一面把會議內容翻譯成外文。
examples.pinyin: Kāng xiǎojiě de gōngzuò nénglì hěn qiáng, néng yīmiàn zhǎngwò huìyì de zhòngdiǎn, yīmiàn bǎ huìyì nèiróng fānyì chéng wàiwén.
examples.english: Miss Kang's work ability is very strong; she can simultaneously grasp the key points of a meeting and translate the meeting content into a foreign language.

items.wordHook: Viewing 重(heavy) scenery at this designated 點(point): 重點 means key point.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠自從改善了設備以後，生產速度就一天比一天快了。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng zìcóng gǎishàn le shèbèi yǐhòu, shēngchǎn sùdù jiù yī tiān bǐ yī tiān kuài le.
examples.english: Ever since that factory improved its equipment, its production speed has become faster day by day.

examples.chinese: 自從有了高速鐵路，不僅縮短了交通時間，人與人之間的距離也變近了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le gāosù tiělù, bùjǐn suōduǎn le jiāotōng shíjiān, rén yǔ rén zhī jiān de jùlí yě biàn jìn le.
examples.english: Ever since there has been high-speed rail, not only has travel time been shortened, but the distance between people has also become closer.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 那棟公寓自從三年前的一場大火之後，就不適合居住了。
examples.pinyin: Nà dòng gōngyù zìcóng sān nián qián de yī chǎng dàhuǒ zhīhòu, jiù bù shìhé jūzhù le.
examples.english: Since a big fire three years ago, that apartment building has not been suitable for residing in.

examples.chinese: 自從有了抽號機以後，人們就不需要站著排隊了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng yǒu le chōuhàojī yǐhòu, rénmen jiù bù xūyào zhànzhe páiduì le.
examples.english: Ever since there have been queue ticket dispensers, people no longer need to stand in line.

examples.chinese: 自從他改變飲食習慣以後，就變得既健康又有活力。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng tā gǎibiàn yǐnshí xíguàn yǐhòu, jiù biàn de jì jiànkāng yòu yǒu huólì.
examples.english: Ever since he changed his eating habits, he has become both healthy and full of vitality.

examples.chinese: 自從住校以後，我得學習自己收拾、整理房間。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhùxiào yǐhòu, wǒ děi xuéxí zìjǐ shōushi, zhěnglǐ fángjiān.
examples.english: Ever since I started living at school, I have had to learn to tidy up and organize my room myself.

examples.chinese: 自從去年伯母退休後，就帶著伯父到處去旅行了。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng qùnián bómǔ tuìxiū hòu, jiù dàizhe bófù dàochù qù lǚxíng le.
examples.english: Ever since my aunt retired last year, she has been taking my uncle traveling everywhere.

examples.chinese: 自從採用專家提供的方法後，茶葉的產量已增加百分之五十。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng cǎiyòng zhuānjiā tígōng de fāngfǎ hòu, cháyè de chǎnliàng yǐ zēngjiā bǎifēnzhī wǔshí.
examples.english: Since adopting the method provided by experts, the production output of tea leaves has increased by 50 percent.

examples.chinese: 自從開始掉頭髮以後，醫師就建議他每天吃半顆維他命。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng kāishǐ diào tóufa yǐhòu, yīshī jiù jiànyì tā měitiān chī bàn kē wéitāmìng.
examples.english: Ever since he started losing hair, the doctor has suggested he take half a vitamin pill every day.

examples.chinese: 自從政府宣布石油、電費雙漲的作法以來，反對的民眾人數已近七成。
examples.pinyin: Zìcóng zhèngfǔ xuānbù shíyóu, diànfèi shuāng zhǎng de zuòfǎ yǐlái, fǎnduì de mínzhòng rénshù yǐ jìn qī chéng.
examples.english: Since the government announced the policy of raising both oil and electricity prices, the number of people opposed has approached seventy percent.

examples.chinese: 開車時萬一發生車禍，千萬要冷靜，以免情況更嚴重。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí wànyī fāshēng chēhuò, qiānwàn yào lěngjìng, yǐmiǎn qíngkuàng gèng yánzhòng.
examples.english: If a car accident happens while driving, one must by all means stay calm, so as to avoid the situation becoming more serious.

examples.chinese: 這個銷售計畫很好，不過得先解決相關費用和推銷人員等現實問題。A:如果現在有一千萬從天上掉下來，那該多好啊！ B:你別再做夢了，趕快回到現實吧！
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoshòu jìhuà hěn hǎo, bùguò děi xiān jiějué xiāngguān fèiyòng hé tuīxiāo rényuán děng xiànshí wèntí. A: Rúguǒ xiànzài yǒu yīqiān wàn cóng tiānshàng diào xiàlái, nà gāi duō hǎo a! B: Nǐ bié zài zuòmèng le, gǎnkuài huídào xiànshí ba!
examples.english: This sales plan is good, but we must first solve realistic problems such as related costs and sales personnel. A: If ten million were to fall from the sky right now, how great that would be! B: Stop dreaming and quickly return to reality!

examples.chinese: 大地震過後才幾天，這個災區的民眾除了收到許多衣服和食物，還收到五千萬元，讓大家又驚訝又感動。
examples.pinyin: Dà dìzhèn guòhòu cái jǐ tiān, zhège zāiqū de mínzhòng chúle shōudào xǔduō yīfu hé shíwù, hái shōudào wǔqiān wàn yuán, ràng dàjiā yòu jīngyà yòu gǎndòng.
examples.english: Only a few days after the major earthquake, the people in this disaster area not only received many clothes and food, but also received fifty million dollars, which made everyone both surprised and moved.

examples.chinese: 談生意時千萬別打斷客戶的話，不然做生意的機會很可能就斷了。
examples.pinyin: Tán shēngyì shí qiānwàn bié dǎduàn kèhù de huà, bùrán zuò shēngyì de jīhuì hěn kěnéng jiù duàn le.
examples.english: When discussing business, never interrupt the client, otherwise the opportunity to do business may very well be broken off.

examples.chinese: 想小便的時候千萬別忍耐，否則對健康的影響相當大。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎng xiǎobiàn de shíhou qiānwàn bié rěnnài, fǒuzé duì jiànkāng de yǐngxiǎng xiāngdāng dà.
examples.english: When you need to urinate, never hold it in, otherwise the impact on your health is considerable.

examples.chinese: 開車時千萬別把頭探出車窗外，以免發生危險。
examples.pinyin: Kāichē shí qiānwàn bié bǎ tóu tàn chū chēchuāng wài, yǐmiǎn fāshēng wēixiǎn.
examples.english: When driving, by all means don't stick your head out of the car window, to avoid danger.

examples.chinese: 千萬別帶著笨重的行李去旅行，那會給你帶來很多麻煩。
examples.pinyin: Qiānwàn bié dài zhe bènzhòng de xíngli qù lǚxíng, nà huì gěi nǐ dàilái hěnduō máfan.
examples.english: By all means don't travel with heavy, cumbersome luggage; that will bring you a lot of trouble.

examples.chinese: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
examples.pinyin: Nǎobù xuèguǎn hěn fùzá, zuò nǎobù shǒushù shí bùnéng yǒu rènhé de chācuò.
examples.english: The blood vessels in the brain are very complex; when performing brain surgery, there must not be any mistake.

examples.chinese: 無論做錯事或出差錯，任何人都應主動負起責任。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn zuòcuò shì huò chū chācuò, rènhé rén dōu yīng zhǔdòng fùqǐ zérèn.
examples.english: Whether you do something wrong or a mistake occurs, anyone should take responsibility proactively.

items.wordHook: 孩(baby) + 子(child) → a young one: 孩子(child).
A 今(now) over a 心(heart) means your thoughts stay in the present → 念(think of).
說(speak) + 話(speech) → 說話 means to talk.
